description: Use when preparing for the Japanese patent attorney examination (弁理士試験) — the short-answer stage (短答), the essay stage (論文 必須・選択) and the oral stage (口述); studying from statutes on e-Gov with the JPO commentary, working past papers under the law in force at the time, building answer-checking tools, and avoiding common traps such as subject minimum scores and law amendments. Also use when writing or checking practice questions and explanations for this exam.
